title: Laid in a Manger
old_p1: Micah, a prophet who spoke for Heavenly Father, lived when Isaiah did. He said little Bethlehem would be special.
Micah said a great Ruler, a leader like a king, would come from there. Bethlehem was King David’s town.
Years later, the leader of Rome said all the people must be counted. So Joseph went to Bethlehem with Mary. Soon she would have a baby.
old_p2: In Bethlehem, baby Jesus was born! Mary wrapped Him snugly in soft cloths. There was no room for them in the inn, a place where travelers stay. So Mary laid Him in a manger, a box that holds food for animals.
Tonight, hug your pillow. You can make room for Jesus in your heart too.
p1: Long ago, Micah told the people what Heavenly Father said. Bethlehem was a little town, but Micah said it would be special.
A great Ruler would come from Bethlehem, King David’s town. Micah was talking about Jesus!
Years later, a ruler named Caesar said everyone must be counted. Joseph was from David’s family, so he took Mary to Bethlehem.
p2: While they were there, baby Jesus was born! Mary wrapped Him snugly in soft cloths. There was no room for them at the inn, where travelers stay. So Mary laid Him in a manger, a little feed box for animals.
Mary and Joseph made a cozy place for Jesus with love. Tonight, you can make room for Jesus in your heart too.
